description: Game pieces (Terrain, Units, Constructs) that can occupy the hex grid.

attackCostScale.description: Multiplier on the AP cost of attacks

buildCharges.description: How many times this entity can build before it is consumed (e.g. settler: 1)

buildables.description: Entity names this entity can build (units for villages, buildings for workers).

elevationAdjustment.description: Multiplier/divisor applied based on relative elevation between attacker and target.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the UI

healthRegenScale.description: HP regenerated per unused AP at turn start

maintenance.description: Resources consumed per turn to keep the entity active.

maxActionPoints.description: Maximum action points (0 = no AP system; build then costs 0 AP)

movement.description: Presence of this object means the entity can move (units); absent = construct.

ordersPerTurn.description: Bonus orders per turn granted by owning this entity

anyOf.description: Ranged attack range in cells (null = melee).

repairAmountPerAp.description: HP restored per AP spent on Repair

repairables.description: Entity names this entity can repair.

rotationOffset.description: Y-axis rotation offset in degrees to orient GLB model correctly

score.description: Score contribution per pillar (all pillars should be present; missing ones default to 0).

sfx.description: Sound effect file names for entity events, relative to sfx.basePath. 'action' may be a file name or an object keyed by action name.

anyOf.description: Maps lowercased action names (e.g. move, attack) to file names; 'default' is the fallback.

action.description: Played when the entity performs an action

build.description: Played when this construct finishes building

damage.description: Played when the entity takes damage

destroy.description: Played when the entity is destroyed

select.description: Played when the entity is selected

sightRange.description: Vision sight range in hex cell radius

spawnConditions.description: Conditions required to spawn or build the entity on a hex cell.

minSeparation.description: Minimum cell distance from any other construct entity.

terrain.description: List of allowed terrain type names the entity can be spawned on.

spawnCost.description: Resources required to build/spawn the entity.

yields.description: Resources produced per turn (only when active and HP > 95%).

title: EntitiesDefinition
